name: Twitter/X sentiment positive + ADX trend — sentiment-confirmed trend (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why bullish X sentiment leads continuation): a positive shift in crypto Twitter/X sentiment marks a narrative gaining momentum — more voices turning bullish drives incremental retail flow before it is fully priced (a swing-horizon lead). Sentiment ALONE is noisy and can spike on hype that never trades, so we require ADX above a floor: a confirmed trend that the bullish social mood is fueling, not a random headline. Distinct from the fear-washout REVERSION on the same feature — this is the CONTINUATION regime (positive sentiment + trend). Exit when sentiment rolls back to neutral/negative (fuel gone). DISCONFIRMER 1: if ADX-trend alone matches the deflated Sharpe, sentiment adds nothing orthogonal. DISCONFIRMER 2: sentiment often LAGS price (the crowd turns bullish AFTER the rally) — if entering on a sentiment DROP does as well, the feature is a coincident price echo, not a lead. Requires XAI_API_KEY; tier1, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: twitter_sentiment is positive (X crowd bullish) AND ADX confirms a real trend.
